audit_name: RoadTwin AI Final Technical & Scientific Honesty Audit

accident_dataset_scale.claim: Historical accident dataset contains 40 chainage-verified crash records from official MoRTH/YEIDA reports.

target_formulation_integrity.claim: target_3h is strictly forward-looking over (T, T+3h].
target_formulation_integrity.evidence: No backward target leakage; lookback features use only past 30d/365d.

chronological_data_split.evidence: Zero temporal data leakage across splits.

feature_space_anonymity.claim: segment_id is excluded from XGBoost feature inputs.
feature_space_anonymity.evidence: 31 features consist exclusively of physical road geometry, diurnal traffic, atmospheric weather, and historical lookbacks.

relative_risk_semantics.claim: Model outputs are relative risk scores / percentiles for tactical prioritization, NOT absolute crash probabilities.
relative_risk_semantics.evidence: API and frontend explicitly display risk_percentile and risk_category (LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, CRITICAL).

traffic_provenance_labeling.claim: Corridor traffic is survey-calibrated diurnal baseline; live mode requires API key and explicitly flags MOCK_OR_UNAVAILABLE when missing.

emergency_facility_labeling.claim: Emergency stations are explicitly designated as SIMULATION_DEPOT.
emergency_facility_labeling.evidence: All API dispatch responses and UI cards label depots as SIMULATION_DEPOT (Decision Support).

vms_policy_labeling.claim: VMS speed limits and messages are decision-support recommendations labeled VMS_POLICY_ASSUMPTION.
vms_policy_labeling.evidence: VMS API responses explicitly return policy_source: VMS_POLICY_ASSUMPTION.

demo_scenario_labeling.claim: 04:00 Winter Fog mode is explicitly labeled DEMO SCENARIO / SYNTHETIC OPERATIONAL INPUT.
demo_scenario_labeling.evidence: API status and frontend mode switcher declare synthetic demo nature.

overall_honesty_status: 100% COMPLIANT WITH SIH 2026 SCIENTIFIC INTEGRITY STANDARDS
